minutes.headline: Committee found all three architect RFQ submittals complete and set interviews for Jan 22 and 29; no ranking yet.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee received three architect RFQ responses and walked through each one's checklist for completeness. It voted that all three packages were complete, then discussed ranking, interview format and scheduling, moving next week's meeting to Thursday Jan 16. A resident raised insurance limits, reference checks, debt exclusion and ballot vote, and hazardous materials surveys.

public_comment.topic: Call for public comment at start; a speaker said they had to leave early and none was taken.
Resident asked about insurance limits, reference checks of firms' past clients, CAD/CAM capability, and what the firm will deliver.
Resident insisted the project go to the ballot as a debt exclusion as well as town meeting, and said he would work to make sure it does.
Resident asked about a hazardous materials survey of the building and the risk of change orders.
Resident raised old septic tanks and pipes on the property and offered an old plan.
Resident asked whether any information exists on a regional trail/asphalt nearby.

votes.motion: Find that all three RFQ packages are complete.

budget_items.what_was_said: Committee checked firms' liability and workers compensation coverage against the minimums in the RFQ.
A resident said the minimum seemed too low for a project this size; members said it is industry standard.

budget_items.topic: Project cost estimate and debt exclusion
budget_items.what_was_said: Members discussed whether a cost estimate would require a debt exclusion and noted operating funds avoid interest.
Members recalled high school abatement allowances coming in under budget and worried about change orders.

decisions.decision: Next meeting moved to Thursday January 16 at 6:00 to review proposals and formulate interview questions.
Interviews tentatively set for January 22 and 29, with ranking done individually beforehand.
Agreed to try to reserve some time for public questions during interviews if not prohibited.
Will request the room for the 22nd and 29th.
Did not extend the RFQ deadline; proceeding with the three submittals.

what_happened.line: The committee voted that all three architect RFQ submittals were complete, after reviewing each against its checklist.
Interviews were tentatively set for January 22 and 29, with members to rank the firms individually beforehand.
The next meeting was moved to Thursday, January 16, at 6:00 to review proposals and draft interview questions.
The committee did not extend the RFQ deadline and went ahead with the three submittals received.
Members agreed to try to reserve time for public questions during interviews, if that is allowed.

why_it_matters: This is the step that picks the architect for the building project, so it shapes the design and cost estimate that residents will later be asked to fund.
Residents raised whether the project should go to a ballot debt exclusion as well as Town Meeting, and that funding route would decide whether the cost lands on tax bills.
